title: Open immersions descend along flat surjective affine morphisms (Stacks 02L3)
statement: Let $S'$ and $S$ be affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $g:S'\to S$ be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism], and let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes. If the second projection $f':X\times_SS'\to S'$ of a fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], then $f$ is an open immersion.
